_comment: Incidents: requests with a face and a deadline (scripts/incidents.gd, Ojon 2026-11-25). Each opens when its 'when' Story conditions hold (story campaigns only), stays on the territory map for 'open_days', and lapses if nobody goes: its 'ignored' effects land and its 'ignored_talk' plays in town. 'rival': opens on the same day; answering one lapses the other. Fields: id, name (the mission's name), province, asker_name (who asks, shown in the briefing), notice (the alert when it opens), stakes and if_ignored (the briefing's first lines), open_days, ask (talk played in town while open), done_talk / ignored_talk (aftermath in town), mission (the mission itself: map, script objective, enemies, rewards, people, bonus, xp, fray, threat), done ({bond, standing} when answered), ignored ({fray: {province: n}, lost: {group: n}, res: {k: -n}, standing, bond, injure: n recruits, injure_days, notice}). speakers and talks are merged into Dialogue.data().

wickham_ask.title: The Lamps of Wickham
lines: maud
You the one in charge? Nobody else would say. Maud Ashby. I light the lamps on the Wickham road.
maud
White's come up the hill. It eats a lamp post, then the next. My lads are still up the ladders, lighting what's left, because nobody told them to stop.
maud
I'm not asking for an army. I'm asking for somebody to go and tell them to come down. Before there's no down to come to.

wickham_intro.title: The Lamps of Wickham
lines: The Wickham road climbs in a line of lamp posts. The top third of the line is white already. Somebody is still up a ladder near the edge, lighting a wick that isn't there.
bran
Light the last ones, so we can see what we're doin'. Then fetch them lads down.

wickham_thanks.title: The Lamps of Wickham
lines: maud
Got them down. All my lads. They're stood in your square looking for something to light.
tobble
We've got lamps. Not many. Get them lit and they can have a drink on the house, the poor beggars.

wickham_dark.title: The Lamps of Wickham
lines: tobble
Wickham's gone dark. Shepherd saw the lamps go out one at a time up the hill road, top to bottom. Nobody came down the ladders.
tobble
Maud Ashby's sat in my taproom. Hasn't said a word. Hasn't touched her drink.

reedmere_ask.title: The Reedmere School
lines: ivett
I teach at Reedmere, in the marsh. Taught. The reedlings have come up out of the water all round the schoolhouse.
ivett
I got out to fetch help. Five children did not. They're on the roof. They were very good about it when I left.

reedmere_intro.title: The Reedmere School
lines: The Reedmere schoolhouse stands on stilts in the marsh. Five small faces look down from its roof at the reedlings swaying below.
bran
Clear the yard. Then the little 'uns come down and we walk out together, nice and slow, like a school trip.

reedmere_thanks.title: The Reedmere School
lines: ivett
They're all asleep in your tavern, on the benches. One of them wants to know if the nobody can come and visit the school.
ivett
I said you were very busy. And that there isn't a school any more. I'll start another. Here, if you'll have it.

reedmere_lost.title: The Reedmere School
lines: tobble
Miss Ivett went back out to the marsh on her own. Took a boat. Said she'd been told to wait long enough.
tobble
Boat came back empty this morning.

fever_ask.title: The Medicine Cart
lines: quill
A matter of public health. There is a fever in the low town, the kind that goes through a street in a week.
quill
The Coven sold us a cart of willow-bark and feverfew. The Guild has impounded it at Gallows Ferry, for 'unpaid ferry duty'. The duty is the price of the cart. Twice.
quill
I would take the cart back myself, but I am a clerk, and they are not.

fever_intro.title: The Medicine Cart
lines: Gallows Ferry. The impounded cart stands by the Guild's toll hut, under a tarpaulin, guarded by people who are paid to stand there.
bran
Guild knows us. Might be bad for trade, this. Then again, so's a fever.

fever_thanks.title: The Medicine Cart
lines: quill
The fever has stopped at two streets. The Guild has sent a strongly worded bill. I have filed it with the others, under 'kindling'.

fever_lost.title: The Medicine Cart
lines: quill
The fever went through the low town, and then up the hill. Half the infirmary beds are full, and nobody built enough of them.
bran
We'll live. Most of us. That's me bein' cheerful.

tull_ask.title: Into the White
lines: tull
My boy Wat went after a lamb. Into the white, in the Meadow. He's eight. The lamb was his.
tull
Everyone says nobody comes back out of it. Then they look at you, and they stop saying it.
bran
They're right. You come out of it once already. Can't say I'd fancy a second go, mind.

tull_intro.title: Into the White
lines: The edge of the white hums. A few paces in, very small and very clear, a boy is sitting holding a lamb, waiting for someone to come and get him.
bran
I'll keep the Nibblers off your back. You do the walkin' in. Don't stay long. Don't forget your name.

tull_thanks.title: Into the White
lines: tull
He won't let go of the lamb. Or of your coat, if you go near him. He says it was quiet in there, and you were the only noise.
tull
Whatever you are, you're ours now. The Tulls don't forget.

tull_lost.title: Into the White
lines: tobble
Agnes Tull sat at the edge of the white all night, in the Meadow. Shepherds saw her there at dawn.
tobble
By noon there was nobody at the edge.

charcoal_ask.title: The Charcoal Burners
lines: gristle
Four burners have a camp deep in the Gutterwoods, dearie. Sold me charcoal thirty years, never once cheated me. Rare, that.
gristle
White's between them and the road now. They're sat on their clamps waiting for it, stubborn as stumps. Fetch them out, would you. For me.

charcoal_intro.title: The Charcoal Burners
lines: Smoke from four charcoal clamps drifts through the trees, and past it, closer than it should be, the white.
gristle
There they are, the daft old things. Shout at them, mind. They're deaf from the fires.

charcoal_thanks.title: The Charcoal Burners
lines: gristle
My burners are in your forge yard, complaining about the wood. Happiest I've seen them in years.
gristle
Owe you one, I do. Don't let it go to your head. I've written it down.

charcoal_lost.title: The Charcoal Burners
lines: gristle
Went to the Gutterwoods myself. Clamps are still smoking. White's just past them. Nobody tending them.
gristle
Thirty years. Never once cheated me. Leave it now.

tollgate_ask.title: The Tollgate
lines: ninefingers
Tollgate on the Tithe Road. Concord's stopping people walking away from the white. Charging a coin a head to pass.
ninefingers
Those that can't pay get struck out on the spot. Saw it done before. Did it once. Not again.
ninefingers
Five families waiting at the bar. Go?

tollgate_intro.title: The Tollgate
lines: A striped bar across the Tithe Road, a toll hut, and a queue of people with handcarts who have been standing there since yesterday.
ninefingers
Toll-clerk's the one with the ledger. Break the bar. I'll do the talking after.

tollgate_thanks.title: The Tollgate
lines: ninefingers
Families are through. Every one. Clerk's ledger is in the river.
ninefingers
Good day. Don't get many.

tollgate_lost.title: The Tollgate
lines: ninefingers
Went past the tollgate. Bar's down. Queue's gone. Clerk's ledger is thicker.
ninefingers
Asked you once. Won't ask about that again.

incidents.name: The Lamps of Wickham
incidents.notice: the Blank is eating the Wickham lamp posts with the lamplighters still up the ladders
incidents.stakes: Three lamplighters up their ladders on the Wickham road, and the lamps that keep the hill road lit.
incidents.if_ignored: Wickham goes dark. The lamplighters are lost, and the Blank gets an easy road onto the hills (Wickham Hills +15 Fray).

mission.brief: The white is eating the lamp posts on the Wickham road, one by one, and Maud Ashby's lamplighters are still up the ladders.

steps.name: a lamplighter
steps.label: Bring the lamplighters down the hill
steps.say: Walk up to the ladders. They'll come down for a voice they don't know.

wickham.saved_text: %d lamplighters from Wickham walk into Hollowmark.
wickham.lost_text: %d of Maud's lamplighters didn't come down.

ignored.notice: Wickham's lamps went out one at a time. Nobody came down the ladders.

incidents.name: The Reedmere School
incidents.notice: five children are stranded on the Reedmere schoolhouse roof with reedlings all round
incidents.stakes: Five children on a schoolhouse roof in Saltreed Marsh, reedlings in the water below.
incidents.if_ignored: The children are lost. Saltreed frays faster without its school (+10 Fray).

mission.brief: Reedlings have come up out of the marsh all round the Reedmere schoolhouse. The schoolmistress got out. Five children did not.

steps.label: Clear the reedlings from the schoolyard

steps.name: a Reedmere child
steps.label: Walk the children out of the marsh

reedmere.saved_text: %d children from Reedmere walk into Hollowmark holding hands.
reedmere.lost_text: %d of the Reedmere children didn't make it out of the marsh.

ignored.notice: Nobody went to Reedmere. The schoolhouse roof is empty.

incidents.name: The Medicine Cart
incidents.notice: the Guild has impounded the low town's fever medicine at Gallows Ferry
incidents.stakes: Hollowmark's low town, a fever spreading street by street, and the cart of medicine that would stop it.
incidents.if_ignored: The fever runs through Hollowmark: two of your people are laid up for days and the stores go on broth (-8 Supplies).

mission.brief: The Guild has impounded a cart of fever medicine at Gallows Ferry for 'unpaid ferry duty'. Hollowmark's low town needs it this week.

steps.label: Find the impounded cart by the toll hut

ignored.notice: The low-town fever went through Hollowmark. Two of your people are in bed for days.

incidents.name: Into the White
incidents.notice: a shepherd's boy walked into the white after his lamb, in the Frayed Meadow
incidents.stakes: Wat Tull, eight years old, a few paces into the Blank. You are the only one who has ever walked back out of it.
incidents.if_ignored: Wat is lost, and his mother after him.

mission.brief: A shepherd's boy walked into the white after his lamb. Everyone says nobody comes back out of it. You did.

objective.label: To the edge of the white

steps.name: Wat Tull
steps.label: Bring Wat back out of the white
steps.say: Walk in after him. Keep your name in your head.

tull.saved_text: Wat Tull walks into Hollowmark with his lamb, holding your coat.
tull.lost_text: Wat Tull didn't come back out of the white.

ignored.notice: Agnes Tull walked into the white after her boy.

incidents.name: The Charcoal Burners
incidents.notice: Mother Gristle's charcoal burners are cut off by the white in the Gutterwoods
incidents.stakes: Four old charcoal burners who have sold Gristle her charcoal for thirty years. Gristle is asking, which she never does.
incidents.if_ignored: The burners are lost, the Gutterwoods fray faster (+10 Fray), and Gristle won't forget who didn't come.

mission.brief: Four charcoal burners are sitting on their clamps deep in the Gutterwoods, waiting for the white. Gristle wants them out.

steps.label: Find the burners' camp by its smoke

steps.name: a charcoal burner
steps.label: Get the burners out ahead of the white

burners.saved_text: %d charcoal burners walk into Hollowmark, grumbling about the wood.
burners.lost_text: %d of the charcoal burners stayed with their clamps.

ignored.notice: The charcoal clamps in the Gutterwoods are still smoking. Nobody is tending them.

incidents.name: The Tollgate
incidents.notice: the Concord is striking out families who can't pay its toll on the Tithe Road
incidents.stakes: Five families at a Concord tollgate who can't pay a coin a head. Daro did this job once. He is asking you to undo it.
incidents.if_ignored: The families are struck out at the bar, and Daro won't ask you for anything again.

mission.brief: The Concord has put a tollgate across the Tithe Road and strikes out anyone fleeing the white who can't pay. Five families are waiting at the bar.

steps.label: Walk up to the toll bar

steps.name: a traveller
steps.label: See the families safely down the road

tollgate.saved_text: %d travellers from the tollgate walk into Hollowmark.
tollgate.lost_text: %d of the travellers were struck out at the bar.
